## Be efficient & accurate:    real-time ready objects in the cloud

![](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/IMG_0872-Copia-2.png)

We employ advanced **mathematical algorithms** to **optimize** the weight in memory of 3D objects, without affecting the quality.

[why AMAZ3D](https://adapta.studio/why/)

![](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/IMG_0872-Copia-2.png)

ADAPTA studio aims at supporting graphic designers and companies in creating **3D models stuck to reality** while reducing computational resources and **time waste**.

- Polygon optimization
- UV preservation
- Level of detail
- Animation preservation
- Normal baking
- Masking
- 3D assets management

![Four colorful 3D rendered chameleons with different textures and file sizes labeled.](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/polygon-optimization.png)

Polygon optimization

**Optimize your 3D asset in terms of memory allocation and object details.**

AMAZ3D implements advanced optimization algorithms which shorten the time from the creation to the employment of your favourite 3D asset.

- Advanced optimization algorithms
- Memory and computational time saving
- User-defined optimization level
- Up to 99% polygon count reduction
- User control on the final number of polygons
- Preserve normals, hard & soft edges
- Minimal quality loss

![3D model of a chameleon, half green and half white.](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/uv-preservation.png)

UV Preservation

**Textured objects can be easily managed by AMAZ3D, so draw your life!**

Recover in a fully automatic way the information displayed on the surface of your object. The texture is properly projected from the original to the AMAZ3D object, even after invasive topological operations.

- Texture preservation algorithms
- UV coordinate recovery
- Texture re-mapping

![3D models of chameleons with different complexities: 258,000 polygons vs. 10,000 polygons.](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/level-of-detail.png)

Level of detail

**Is your object on the background or on the foreground? No problem in any case.**

AMAZ3D allows the user to reach the desired Level Of Detail (LOD). It’s enough to set the number of polygons of your AMAZ3D object.

Make your LOD creation automatic in few seconds with AMAZ3D.

- User-defined LOD with LOD chain preset
- Tunable number of polygons
- LOD creation with quality preservation
- From unprepped 3D data with millions of polygons to realtime ready objects in seconds

![3D rendering of a stylized white chameleon with a curled tail.](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/animation-preservation.png)

Animation Preservation

**AMAZ3D allow users to preserve animations, bones, skin and rigs during the optimization process.**

AMAZ3D LOD creation module employs advanced mathematical techniques to preserve animation during the LOD creation.

You won’t have to re-apply animations after optimization, just use AMAZ3D to optimize asset from your browser.

- Create LOD preserving animations
- Preserve skins, rigs, bones and armatures while reducing polygon count

![Three geometric 3D renderings with shapes casting shadows.](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/normal-baking.png)

Normal baking

**AMAZ3D allows user to bake a normal map from the high poly to the low poly model.**

AMAZ3D baking tools are what you need to transfer data from high poly asset to the low poly one after optimization

- Tunable normal map quality
- Multiple file formats
- OpenGL and DirectX compatibility

![3D model of a stylized cartoon dragon.](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/masking.png)

Masking

**AMAZ3D lets users paint areas of the mesh. not to optimize.**

AMAZ3D masking tool uses vertex paint to identify areas to leave untouched. You can use this tool to weight optimization in the areas you prefer. Please take a look at how to do it in this [video.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J5jvXFgmJMo)

- Use vertex paint to guide your optimization
- Autorship for artist restored

![Screenshot of a user interface with multiple windows displaying project management and 3D modeling tools.](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/cms-workflow.png)

3D assets management

**Manage all your 3D art with the same platform connected to any software you already use!**

The platform is connected through plugins to DCC softwares and engines, providing you a smart way to manage your 3D asset rough multiple applications. The platform is also completed by a 3D white label viewer and a 3D asset optimization tool that is far better than any competitor.

**Optimize** and **manage 3D assets** with **innovative algorithms**

AMAZ3D helps you in the optimization and management of 3D assets exploiting algorithms based on advanced mathematical techniques to reduce the weight in memory of 3D objects – **up to 90% less memory usage**– while preserving the initial quality of your asset.

![](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/cham_sfondo_v3.jpg)![](https://adapta.studio/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/cham_mesh_v3.jpg)
